prerequisites.condition: Live ordinary-vs-protected PR mergeability/approval behavior independently observed at exact head and enforced
Required computational status contexts enforced and relevant Sage/native/on-demand suites digest/hash pinned with immutable PASS/FAIL receipts
All critical ACSC/ECC/GLMPCT obstructions relevant to tested map are proven, narrowed or disclosed as bounded assumptions with tests
Larger prospective arithmetic pilot run with repeatable results, independent invariant implementation and recorded failures
Physical E/Q-to-observable rule and units derived or explicitly hypothesized independently of galaxy labels and outcomes, with identifiability test
Exact source releases+SQL, SHA-256 bytes, row and schema checks, join cardinalities, sky mask and radial selection established
ONE primary endpoint, holdout cohort, rivals, spatial/arithmetic null exchangeability and alpha frozen before observational endpoint is inspected

stop_conditions: Any nonmatching source digest, inconsistent units, ambiguous crossmatch, target leakage, after-outcome tuning, broken null exchangeability, or failed control is a hard stop.
A completed source-hash check never certifies observations are accurate or a physical theory is true.
Any P1 contradiction open in the exact mechanism domain blocks confirmatory execution.
